r5900-mfc1.status: qualified per source for USA level bodies only
r5900-mfc1.provenance: GNU EE assembler built from OpenRAC/rac2-decomp's versioned R5900 mfc1 interlock source transformation (tools/compiler/transformers/r5900_mfc1_interlock.py, commit e07c4844d64b007377031e49c683d57fba8db07c). The patch exempts only mfc1 from the obsolete coprocessor-load delay while keeping the retail floating-condition delay. The separately measured 148-byte level body is exact at all 20 USA placements; the base assembler remains the route for all other accepted sources. A 436-byte level body that stores a float through its integer bits (mfc1 followed by a store) links with 31 differing words under the base assembler and exactly with this route at its twelve USA placements, from one representative and eleven per-placement address variants (November 2026). This external binary is hash-pinned and never committed.

ee-frozen.status: qualified per source for USA level bodies only
ee-frozen.provenance: Private EE assembler recovered with the legally supplied toolchain used in the RAC1 workspace. On the pinned USA body at LEVEL_01:0x001940, the default GNU assembler emits 96 bytes and misses the retail floating-point latency and delay-slot schedule; this hash-pinned binary emits the exact 100-byte body at all 20 numbered level placements. It is selected only for the measured source, never globally, and the external binary is not distributed. A per-placement address variant of LEVEL_02_08EA20.c is exact at its own USA placement with the same route (November 2026).

ps2eeas.status: qualified per source for USA level bodies only
ps2eeas.provenance: SN Systems Ps2EeAs 1.8.19.316, the privately supplied EE assembler already pinned for the boot reconstruction in config/boot/compiler_trial.json. On the measured 192-byte level body the pinned GNU assembler expands the 64-bit constant as ori/dsll16 and links 216 bytes, while this assembler emits the retail lui/ori/dsll3/ori chain and reproduces all 18 USA placements exactly. A separate 132-byte body is exact at twenty USA placements from five per-source variants with the same pinned assembler. Two further 32- and 112-byte forms are exact at nineteen USA placements each; 36 new canonical source files use this same qualified per-source route, and the 21 complete modules remain exact. A 72-byte two-word record return links 72/72 bytes with one differing word under the pinned GNU assembler, which loads the 0xFFFFFFFF mask with lui instead of the retail addiu; this assembler reproduces all thirteen USA placements of that form from one source (November 2026). Five per-placement address variants of sources already on this route (LEVEL_02_0023B0.c, LEVEL_02_050448.c, LEVEL_02_06E1E0.c and LEVEL_03_0497A0.c) are exact at their own USA placements with the same route (November 2026). Selected only for the measured sources, never globally; the external binary is not distributed.

scope: two shared C witnesses at twenty pinned LEVEL_*.REL placements and func_00002F80 in FRONTEND.REL; additional accepted level bodies and their per-source routes are governed by config/levels/body_sources.tsv
